steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then Miss Cabernet, can you tell us what exactly are these treasures you've lost?
After the guest leaves, you guys remain in place and exchange the information you have as if having a leisurely chat.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Umm... Food ingredients.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Food ingredients? To my knowledge, the host of this party is one of the top chefs in Eastside. She should have many channels to procure ingredients, and shouldn't need to...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Before I came, I also asked my old colleagues to do a bit of checking. The chef didn't seem to have any financial transactions that were out of the ordinary...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Recently, there have been rumors going around Eastside about a "legendary ingredient"... How did they describe it? A type of mermaid meat that can fulfill wishes...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: But those are just rumors, after all. They can't be true...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Who knows. But I think that my ingredients are not particularly noteworthy to other people.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: If I tell them what it is, they might be surprised by my choice... But to me, they're treasures.
Cabernet seems a bit sad, looking down at the ground.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Don't worry, I understand.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You understand...?

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: I've met many people who can only bury their true thoughts in their hearts. They all need someone who understands them, and whom they can confide in.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: A top gourmet can also enjoy so-called "common food" and regard it as a treasure. It's no big deal.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: But if you feel pent-up stress about it...
Macchiato touches the whip on her waist, her smile becoming wider.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Perhaps I can help?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ahaha, no, no need... I do think Miss Cabernet needs someone who'll support her in using common ingredients, but...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whipping won't be necessary...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Ah... I see.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Haha... Thank you. I must say... Those who work for the MBCC Chief really know their stuff!
You find this client a bit hard to read—She recognized your identities right away, and gave you information and support.
But those "unnecessary engagements" she spoke of didn't decrease at all. On the contrary, even you guys became the center of attention.
This exposes all your actions to everyone. Every little thing you do is magnified.
The only advantage to this is that it won't be so easy for the host of the party to harm you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Right now, we know too little about this dinner banquet, so we can only go along with the host's plans step by step.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But in any case, at least we can confirm that the dinner banquet is the most important part of this party. There may be information about the treasures there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Before that, please try your best to collect as much information as possible...
My goodness! Miss Macchiato! It's really you!
Did you really hear the song I just sang?
A tanned, muscular man walks up to Macchiato, his voice full of surprise.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Ah... wh-what song... haha... Mr. Ryan, what are you talking about? I don't understand...

steps.speaker: Ryan
steps.content: It's fine, no worries! I'm just surprised you actually showed up! And you know Miss Cabernet so well, too!

steps.speaker: Ryan
steps.content: Come and catch up with us! There are a lot of people here who know you!
The muscular man shows off his muscles and strikes a pose before the crowd.
Macchiato looks over at where Ryan is pointing, then whispers in your ear.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: A couple of the guests over there work in the food and beverage industry. I might be able to get some information about this dinner from them.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: It's a good opportunity, Chief.

steps.speaker: One second later, he would have died in my hands... Were you trying to stop me?
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Don't worry, I can protect myself...
Macchiato smiles at you. The smile is genuine, as if to tell you not to worry.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right, then. I'll be here at all times. If anything happens...
You wave your hands, signaling the "shackles."
You let go after seeing Macchiato nod. She and Ryan turn to leave.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Thank you and the others for remembering me. I'll go with you, then...
You're still a bit worried as you watch them leave, so you leave a few words with Kelvin and go after them.
Those guys surround Macchiato and come to the side of an elevator in the northwest. After a while, you hear a bunch of raunchy noises.
You feel the shackles in your hands twitch slightly. Worried, you hide next to the elevator and take a peek...

steps.speaker: Big Tall Man A
steps.content: Again, Miss Macchiato! Just once more! Please! Let me have it!

steps.speaker: Big Tall Man B
steps.content: Me, too! Me, too! Look, Miss Macchiato, my pose is on point! Shouldn't I get it first?

steps.speaker: Big Tall Man C
steps.content: Miss Macchiato can choose whoever she wants! Who let you choose for her?!

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Haha... you're right. Excellent! I'll start with... you!
To your bewilderment, the sound of leather striking against skin rings out repeatedly from the narrow space.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Huh? Chief... it's you?
Macchiato is a bit surprised to hear your voice, but she maintains the sharp look on her face, nor does her hand stop.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Sorry you had to see that, Chief...

steps.speaker: Are you too weak after the suspended animation? Or is the wooden box nailed shut?
steps.content: It's fine! Um...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You scratch your head, think for a while, then ask:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are they... all right?

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Don't worry. They're all my former customers. This is just a little reward for them.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Thus, they will answer all my questions without reservation. See you in a bit, Chief.
Macchiato waves to you, then cracks her whip again.
Fanning your flustered ears, you quietly walk back to Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Chief, your face is bright red... are you feeling too hot?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Try some of this. Miss Macchiato's friend brought it over and said it's delicious.
As a token of thanks for letting him borrow Macchiato, Ryan had given each of you a cup of ice cream before he left.

steps.speaker: Ryan
steps.content: It tastes delicious! Plus, you can also press it against any part of your body that hurts! The cold stimulation is also quite refreshing!
Remembering how Ryan winked at you, you have a hard time taking a bite.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: This is the ice cream those swimsuit girls were feeding... hehe, I mean, sharing with me just now. It really is quite tasty. Would you like some, Miss Cabernet?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Really? How tasty is it?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: It tastes sweet and smooth, with traces of lemon and sea salt. It's not heavy at all! Quite refreshing, actually!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Though I've never been to the ocean, I feel like this is the taste of the sea!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What an apt description. Makes me feel as if I tasted it myself... Seems that even the ice cream here is made from exquisite ingredients...
Kelvin is a bit bashful from the praise. She smiles at you, then gobbles another spoonful of ice cream.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: But this serving tastes a bit different.
Kelvin smacks her lips, then sticks out her tongue and gently licks the spoon.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: It's more savory than the one I had earlier. It feels like the same recipe, but with some... meat added to the ingredients.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: But I can't really taste the meat, just the texture... hmm... maybe...
Having finished the portion in her hand, Kelvin glances at yours and asks:

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Chief, can I have some more?
You give the untouched ice cream to Kelvin.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Thank you, Chief!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Hmm... This ice cream is indeed different from the ones earlier, but... it's still quite yummy.
You watch Kelvin stuff the ice cream into her mouth. Things feel a bit strange.
Though Kelvin can only taste frozen things, she has never displayed such a voracious appetite for any other food.
Cabernet also stares at the ice cream in silence.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Ah... Finished another one...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Don't eat too much. There's going to be dinner soon.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: If you eat too much ice cream now, you won't have room to eat more delicious things later.
Cabernet puts her ice cream on a table a bit further away, and sits between it and Kelvin.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Right! There's still the dinner banquet!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Though I do want to have another bite... since Miss Cabernet says so, I'll leave some room for dinner!
Ting-a-ling...
The jingling of bells interrupts your conversation.
A uniformed maid with a little bell comes out of the poolside restaurant, calling to everyone.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Sorry for disturbing everyone.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: The head chef told me to inform everyone that the soup is ready.
Upon hearing that the appetizer is ready, the guests in the pool cheer and start heading towards the restaurant.
Some linger in the corner. They had started satiating their appetites a long time ago, and refuse to leave.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Let's go. It's disrespectful to the chef to be late for the meal.
